host.commands.seed_description: Run the seeders in order (--only <name,...> to pick some, --list to show them without running).
host.commands.seeder_unknown: Unknown seeder '{name}'. Run 'seed --list' to show the seeders.
host.commands.schema_description: Schema upgrade: schema upgrade runs the upgrade scripts newer than the version ledger and adds the missing tables and columns from the entities (platform and dedicated tenant databases); schema plan only previews the changes without applying them.
